title: Non-blocking findings from PR #272's review (Daily Homework follow-ups PR)
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's full review of PR #272 (frontend-daily-homework-page-followups), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: `DailyHomeworkForm.tsx` calls `useYesterdayTradingSuggestion()` unconditionally (no `enabled` gate), so the suggestion request still fires -- and is left in flight -- even when today's entry already exists and its result is provably unused. This contradicts the component's own doc comment, which claims the suggestion query 'is skipped entirely once an existing entry makes it moot' -- verified via a real browser walkthrough (existing-entry case): the request was seen firing even with a 10s artificial delay on it, while the form+banner rendered immediately from the existing entry. The parent checklist item this PR closed only asked to stop *waiting* on the query in that case, which was correctly implemented -- but the fetch itself remains wasteful. The codebase already has an established `enabled:`-gating pattern elsewhere (`useIndicatorHistory.ts`, `useStockHistory.ts`, `useStockAnalysis.ts`) that could gate this call on `!existingEntry` once `todayQuery` has settled. Also correct the doc comment's 'skipped entirely' wording to describe what actually happens (the wait is skipped, not the fetch) regardless of whether the fetch itself gets fixed.

`HomeworkScoreBanner.tsx`'s 'is this the high-yellow (9-10) too-perfect band' condition (`band === 'yellow' && totalScore >= 9`) is duplicated three times (`iconFor`, the inline JSX label-suffix check, and implicitly as `totalScore >= 9` inside `messageFor`'s yellow branch) instead of being computed once and reused. A future change to the threshold or band naming could update one or two of the three and silently leave the others out of sync (e.g. the icon shows but the label suffix doesn't). Consider a single `const isTooPerfect = band === 'yellow' && totalScore >= 9` computed once in the component and passed to/reused by all three call sites.
